name: Deluge Pull
description: Drag the opponent forward on a deluge current and strike the body as it arrives.

name: Deluge Wash
description: Wash an ally in a flood of clean qi that strips out poison and curse residue.

name: Deluge Veil
description: Hold a falling veil of heavy water qi that dulls the strikes of several attackers.

name: Deluge Lash
description: Lash a heavy deluge across the guard so the strike lands and the arms are flung wide.

name: Deluge Crash
description: Bring the weight of a whole deluge down through one fist onto the target.

name: Smothering Deluge
description: Hold a field of falling flood over the nearby opponents until they cannot stand or breathe freely.

name: Deluge Mantle
description: Wear a mantle of deluge that stops strikes at its edge and presses the qi of those who touch it.

name: Deluge Renewal
description: Call down a gentle deluge over a person whose breath has just stopped and wake the heart again.

name: Deluge Seal
description: Drown a foe's qi paths in still heavy water until the qi cannot rise for a long span.

name: Deluge Flash
description: Burst into a rush of water and surge to the far edge of the field in a single breath.

name: Deluge Spear
description: Compress a deluge to one hard spear of water that pierces any guard it meets.

name: Deluge Crown
description: Raise the school's crowning deluge in three beats of pull and crush and wash that end on the target.

name: Worldflood
description: Raise a flood to the destructive ceiling of the user's tier that drowns the whole field and all that stands in it.

name: Cataract Pull
description: Drag the opponent down a falling sheet of qi and strike as the body lands.

name: Cataract Mend
description: Let a thin high cataract of healing qi fall over an ally's deep wounds until they knit.

name: Cataract Sense
description: Read from the sound of falling water qi the number and weight of all bodies below it.

name: Cataract Veil
description: Hang a falling veil of core-fed water that drives down the force of strikes.

name: Cataract Crush
description: Drop the cataract through a single fist to crush the target and the ground beneath it.

name: Cataract Rain
description: Rain the cataract's spray down across the field in hard drops that batter all in reach.

name: Cataract Shroud
description: Pull the falling cataract round the body as a roaring shroud that nothing passes through unhurt.

name: Cataract Rebirth
description: Pour a high cataract over a fallen ally whose breath has just stopped to start the heart anew.

name: Cataract Reversal
description: Turn the cataract upward against a heavy strike and fling its force back on the sender.

name: Cataract Siphon
description: Draw the qi of a foe up the falling water until the foe is hollowed and slow.

name: Cataract Passage
description: Dissolve into the falling water and step through a barrier to re-form behind it.

name: Cataract Rite
description: Perform the school's rite of the falling water in three linked strokes of guard and pull and crush.

name: Cataract Fall
description: Drop the whole cataract on the field with force up to the destructive ceiling of the user's tier.

name: Heaven Cataract
description: Call a single sky-high column of water onto one target with force at the destructive ceiling of the user's tier.

name: Boundless Pull
description: Pull the opponent across the field on an edgeless current and strike the arriving body.

name: Boundless Wash
description: Wash an ally in a boundless clean flow that carries off poison and soul erosion.

name: Boundless Mend
description: Pour boundless healing water over an ally until the deepest wounds close.

name: Endless Veil
description: Draw an endless veil of divine water round the body that thins every strike that meets it.

name: Boundless Crush
description: Bring the weight of unending water down through one fist onto the target.

name: Boundless Undertow
description: Spread an edgeless field of water over the ground that drags every opponent beneath it.

name: Boundless Revival
description: Send a boundless flow into a fallen ally whose breath has just stopped to bring the heart back.

name: Boundless Mantle
description: Wear a mantle of divine water that stops blows and weighs on the qi of whoever strikes.

name: Boundless Seal
description: Hold a foe's whole qi system under still deep water so nothing can stir for a long span.

name: Boundless Absorb
description: Take a ruinous strike into an edgeless body of water and keep the force as reserve.

name: Boundless Flash
description: Burst into water and reform at the far side of the field before the water has fallen.

name: Boundless Tide
description: Raise the school's boundless tide in three beats of pull and crush and cleansing wash.

name: Boundless Embrace
description: Wrap every ally in reach in boundless water that closes wounds and refills the spent reserve.

name: Drowning Heaven
description: Pour a sky of water on the whole field with force up to the destructive ceiling of the user's tier.

name: Tidefall Oblivion
description: Raise and drop a tide that scours the field to bare ground at the destructive ceiling of the user's tier.
